title: Roasted Syrian Reblochon Gratin
description: A rich and creamy reblochon gratin infused with the flavors of roasted syrian, topped with a crispy crust.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, mix reblochon cheese, roasted Syrian, garlic, and thyme.
Transfer the cheese mixture to one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border.
Brush the edges with water and fold the other half over the filling.
Crimp the edges to seal and cut a few slits in the top.
Brush the top with egg wash and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Increase oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
